business_summary: Tootsie Roll Industries, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells confectionery products in the United States, Canada, Mexico, and internationally. The company sells its products under the Tootsie Roll, Tootsie Fruit Roll, Tootsie Pops, Tootsie Mini Pops, Child's Play, Caramel Apple Pops, Charms, Blow-Pop, Charms Mini Pops, Cella's, Dots, Junior Mints, Charleston Chew, Sugar Daddy, Sugar Babies, Andes, Fluffy Stuff, Dubble Bubble, Razzles, Cry Baby, Nik-L-Nip, And Tutsi Pop trademarks. It sells its products directly to wholesale distributors of candy, food and groceries, supermarkets, variety stores, dollar stores, chain grocers, drug chains, discount chains, cooperative grocery associations, mass merchandisers, warehouse and membership club stores, vending machine operators, e-commerce merchants, on-line marketplaces, the U.S. military and fund-raising charitable organizations, as well as through food and grocery brokers. Tootsie Roll Industries, Inc. was founded in 1896 and is headquartered in Chicago, Illinois.
business_summary_ko: Tootsie Roll Industries, Inc.는 자회사와 함께 미국, 캐나다, 멕시코 및 해외에서 제과 제품을 제조 및 판매합니다. 이 회사는 Tootsie Roll, Tootsie Fruit Roll, Tootsie Pops, Tootsie Mini Pops, Child's Play, Caramel Apple Pops, Charms, Blow-Pop, Charms Mini Pops, Cella's, Dots, Junior Mints, Charleston Chew, Sugar Daddy, Sugar Babies, Andes, Fluffy Stuff, Dubble Bubble, Razzles, Cry Baby, Nik-L-Nip, Andes라는 이름으로 제품을 판매합니다. 투치팝 상표. 사탕, 식품 및 식료품 도매 유통업체, 슈퍼마켓, 잡화점, 달러 상점, 식료품점 체인점, 약국 체인점, 할인 체인점, 식료품 협동조합 협회, 대량 판매점, 창고 및 회원 클럽 상점, 자판기 운영자, 전자 상거래 상인, 온라인 마켓플레이스, 미군 및 기금 모금 자선 단체는 물론 식품 및 식료품 중개인을 통해 제품을 직접 판매합니다. Tootsie Roll Industries, Inc.는 1896년에 설립되었으며 일리노이주 시카고에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
